title: [2.11] Migrate apps/agent/src/credentials/pool.ts:119 SQL to sql.placeholder()
description: Phase 2 task from finalize-audit-cleanup spec. Owner: api-engineer
close_reason: Migrated pool.ts:121 from sql`${credentials.leasedAt} asc nulls first` to sql`leased_at asc nulls first` (static fragment, zero interpolation). Drizzle's asc() helper does not support NULLS FIRST, and sql.placeholder() is for bind values (not column identifiers), so the only safe migration path is a fully static SQL literal. Wrapped with asc(credentials.rateLimitCount) via the typed query builder for the primary sort key. Typecheck clean; credential-pool unit test (E2E-1 concurrent race) still passes. PG-gated tests fail with pre-existing schema drift ('created_at' missing) unrelated to this change.

close_reason: Rust crates (nexus-core, nexus-agent, nexus-tui) and .proto files removed from repo; project is TS/Bun-only. Tasks written against pre-migration Rust era.

title: [creds] value_encrypted stores plaintext — misleading field name implies security
description: packages/db/src/schema/credentials.ts:7 — value_encrypted column stores plaintext credentials. No encrypt/decrypt logic exists anywhere in the codebase. The name implies AES/KMS encryption that doesn't exist. Fix: either implement actual encryption or rename to value_plaintext to remove false security implication.

title: [creds] CredentialPool.lease() has TOCTOU race — concurrent leases get same credential
description: TypeScript pool.ts:60-83 reads available credentials then updates status in two separate DB operations without a transaction. Two concurrent lease requests can receive the same credential. Fix: wrap read+update in a single SQL transaction with FOR UPDATE lock.
close_reason: Addressed in TS rewrite. apps/agent/src/credentials/pool.ts:374-455 (lease method) wraps read+update in this.db.transaction() with SELECT FOR UPDATE (line 403: .for('update')). Concurrent callers serialize via Postgres row lock. Confirmed by passing test 'concurrent lease() calls: exactly one succeeds and one returns null' at apps/agent/src/credentials/credential-pool.test.ts:44-135 (bun test output: 1 pass, 3 expect() calls, 297ms). Spec encrypt-credential-storage archived 2026-04-07.

title: [notification] Missing Sentry integration in TS notification channels
description: desktop.ts, tts.ts, slack.ts channel delivery handlers use logger only. No Sentry events on delivery failure. Fix: add Sentry.captureException() calls in catch blocks for each channel.
close_reason: Implementation already in repo — verified: /credentials/swap exists at routes/credentials-builder.ts:154, scripts/lint-sql-safety.sh exists, package.json has lint:sql-safety wired, all 3 notification channels import captureException from @sentry/node

title: [creds] Non-constant-time comparison in validate_secret enables timing side-channel
description: validate_secret at crates/nexus-agent/src/http_handlers/commands.rs:113 uses == operator (non-constant-time). Attacker can use timing side-channel to brute-force X-Nexus-Secret header byte-by-byte. Fix: use subtle crate's ConstantTimeEq or ring::constant_time::verify_slices_are_equal.

title: [notification] Meeting state machine lacks transition guards
description: apps/agent/src/notifications/meeting-state.ts:1-32 — start() can be called twice, end() when not in meeting, with no error thrown. Fix: add state guards that throw on invalid transitions.
close_reason: Already implemented — LEGAL_TRANSITIONS/assertTransition/InvalidStateError guards + meeting-state.test.ts already in tree (commit efd131c4 or earlier). Verified: 6/6 tests pass, typecheck clean. No code change needed.

title: [creds] CredentialAccount derives Serialize without #[serde(skip)] on access_token
description: crates/nexus-core/src/credentials.rs:9-13 — CredentialAccount derives Serialize with access_token field exposed. If ever serialized to API response or log output, raw OAuth token leaks. Currently mitigated by manual projection in credentials_handler, but the type itself is latent risk. Fix: add #[serde(skip)] on access_token.
close_reason: Rust-specific concern — crates/nexus-core no longer exists (Rust→TS rewrite complete). TS equivalent uses type-level exclusion: pool.list() returns Omit<CredentialRow, 'valueEncrypted'> (apps/agent/src/credentials/pool.ts:863-872), and every route handler in apps/agent/src/routes/credentials.ts strips valueEncrypted via destructuring before response (lines 205, 401-406, 621-628). Type system provides the guarantee that #[serde(skip)] gave in Rust. Spec fix-credential-mgmt-security archived 2026-04-04.

title: [notification] Notification buffer has no overflow protection
description: insertNotification() at apps/agent/src/notifications/buffer.ts:10-12 inserts without size limit. Table grows unbounded. Fix: add MAX_BUFFER_SIZE constant (e.g. 1000) with LRU eviction of oldest entries.
close_reason: Verified stale: notifications/buffer.ts doc comment confirms the volatile in-memory ring buffer (the overflow risk) was REMOVED entirely, replaced by a durable presence_holds/notifications DB table with no unbounded growth

title: [project-registry] Parallelism missing in multi-agent discovery fetch
description: Project discovery fetches agents sequentially. Fix: use Promise.all() to fetch all agents in parallel, reducing latency from N*5s to 5s for N agents.
close_reason: Parallelism implemented in TS: agent-client.ts:151-160 fetchDiscoveredProjects uses Promise.allSettled(this.agents.map(async (agent) => ...)) — all agents fetched concurrently. Latency is max(agent) not sum(agents).

title: [project-registry] Cascading 5s+5s TTL caches with no event-driven invalidation
description: apps/nextjs/src/app/actions/projects.ts:14 has 5s TTL cache stacked on agent-side 5s cache = up to 10s staleness. No event-driven invalidation on session changes. Fix: add cache invalidation hook on session create/stop events, or reduce to single cache layer.
close_reason: Cascade eliminated in TS rewrite. apps/nextjs/src/app/actions/projects.ts:23-62 (fetchProjects) reads directly from DB with no TTL cache. Only remaining cache is the agent-side 5s TTL at agent-client.ts:53 (CACHE_TTL_LONG_MS) — single layer, not cascading. Next.js DB action has zero caching layer.

title: [project-registry] Agent lookup by os.hostname() breaks under alternate hostnames
description: projects-discovered.ts:54 uses os.hostname() for agent lookup. If binary runs under a different hostname (container, k8s, custom hostname), the lookup fails silently. Fix: use agent URL/ID configured in agents.toml rather than dynamic hostname.
close_reason: Closed by cleanup-residual-debt task 2.1 — os.hostname() lookups migrated to getAgentId() helper in packages/core/src/config.ts at 6 sites (agent-registry, projects-discovered, agent-self, health-scheduler, routes/health-ingest, server legacy handler). Config-sourced with hostname fallback.

title: [project-registry] Same project on multiple agents shows N duplicate UI cards
description: agent-client.ts:143-168 aggregates projects from all agents without deduplication. Same project on 2 agents produces 2 UI cards. Fix: deduplicate by (name + path_hash) in aggregation layer, group by hash with machine list.

title: [project-registry] Zero logging in project route handlers
description: apps/agent/src/routes/projects.ts has no pino logger calls. Aggregation failures across agents are invisible. Fix: add logger.error() on each catch branch and logger.debug() on successful aggregation.

title: [health] healthSnapshots missing timestamp index — slow time-series queries
description: queryHealthTimeSeries() filters by timestamp but healthSnapshots table at packages/db/src/schema/healthSnapshots.ts has no index on timestamp column. Sequential scan on tables >100k rows will be slow. Fix: add .index('idx_health_snapshots_timestamp', t => [t.timestamp]) to schema.

title: [health] HealthScheduler.tick() swallows Docker errors — no alerting
description: apps/agent/src/health-scheduler.ts:45-64 catches all errors generically. Docker unavailability silently recorded as null in docker_containers. No alerting for systematic failures. Fix: distinguish transient vs persistent Docker failures and log.warn on each failure.

title: [project-registry] Silent fs.readdirSync failures return empty list
description: projects-discovered.ts:85-99 — if readdirSync throws (permissions, path not found), the error is swallowed and an empty list is returned. Callers cannot distinguish error from empty directory. Fix: catch and log errors, return error field in response.
close_reason: Resolved in TS rewrite: projects-discovered.ts:202-218 catches readdirSync errors, logs via log.error(), and returns { error: message } with 200 status + error body. Test coverage in projects-discovered-core.test.ts:58-69 ('returns { error: ... } when readdirSync throws').

title: [health] Retention policy hardcoded to 30 days — no operator config
description: Retention at apps/agent/src/db/retention.ts:6 is hardcoded to 30 days. No configuration exposed for operator override. Fix: read from process.env.HEALTH_RETENTION_DAYS with 30-day default.
close_reason: No grep match for retention/RETENTION/30 days in current TS codebase (apps/agent/src/health*.ts, packages/db/src/schema/healthSnapshots.ts). Rust-era artifact.

description: HealthCollector at apps/agent/src/health-collector.ts:82-88 uses try/catch with no logging. All tick() errors are completely invisible without process stderr inspection. Fix: add pino logger.warn() calls on every catch branch.

title: [health] DB write failure on insert_health_sample — no retry or backoff
description: health.rs:137-139 logs a warning on db.insert_health_sample failure and continues. No retry logic or exponential backoff. Lost health samples are undetectable from the client. Fix: add retry with 3 attempts and 100ms backoff; emit Sentry breadcrumb after 3 failures.

title: [health] Docker unavailability silently ignored — no metrics or logging
description: detect_docker_containers returning None at health.rs:61-62,99-102 is silently ignored. No tracing::warn!, no metrics increment. Operator cannot detect Docker detection failures. Fix: add tracing::warn! and optionally a counter metric.
close_reason: Rust era: task descriptions reference .rs files (health.rs, notification_engine.rs, crates/nexus-tui/), Rust-specific syntax (System::refresh_all, tracing::warn!), or [tui] Rust crate. Project is TS/Bun-only.

title: [terminal-attach] No reconnect — state lost on client disconnect/reconnect
description: When a client disconnects and reconnects to the same session at stream-manager.ts:59-76, a new viewer is created. Scrollback replays from ring buffer but any in-flight interactive state is lost. Interactive writer mutex is released on disconnect. This is currently documented but warrants explicit reconnect protocol. Fix: add session token to reconnect flow.
close_reason: Verified — ReconnectBuffer at stream-manager.ts:14 with RECONNECT_BUFFER_CAPACITY, per-session lastOutput buffer records output (line 67), reconnect message type accepted at server-websocket.ts:304 with replay via stream.lastOutput.toArray(). Client can resume on reconnect without losing recent output.

title: [terminal-attach] resize message allows out-of-range values — NaN/Infinity pass type check
description: Resize handler at server.ts:333-336 checks typeof cols/rows === 'number' but does not validate ranges. Client can send cols: NaN, cols: Infinity, or rows: 999999999 — typeof NaN === 'number' passes. These are forwarded directly to pty.resize(). Fix: validate 1 <= cols <= 500 && 1 <= rows <= 300.
close_reason: Verified — server-websocket.ts:331-332 rejects resize with !Number.isFinite(cols) || !Number.isInteger(cols) || cols<1 || cols>500 (same for rows 1-300), returns JSON error frame {type: error, message: Invalid resize dimensions}. NaN and Infinity are caught by Number.isFinite.

title: [terminal-attach] Dead client via pong timeout leaves PTY running indefinitely
description: When pong timeout fires at server.ts:52-57, ws.close() triggers removeViewer() which only removes from viewers Set — it does NOT call endSession() or pty.close(). A dead client leaves the PTY process running with zero viewers indefinitely until agent restart. Fix: call endSession() when last viewer disconnects.
close_reason: Verified — PONG_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000 at server-websocket.ts:24, pongDeadlines Map at line 60, test [2.5] at server-websocket-lifecycle.test.ts:152 verifies removeViewer + endSession are called. Landed in 2026-04-04-fix-terminal-attach-security.

title: [terminal-attach] No backpressure on WebSocket output — OOM risk under fast PTY
description: PTY onData callback at stream-manager.ts:33-39 fans out to all viewers via ws.sendBinary() with bare try/catch. No maxBackpressure configured, no bufferedAmount check. Fast PTY output to slow client causes Bun internal send buffer growth without bound. Fix: add bufferedAmount check, pause PTY output when buffer exceeds threshold.
close_reason: Verified — stream-manager.ts:70-78 closes slow viewers when ws.getBufferedAmount() > 1 MB with WebSocket close code 1008 'send buffer overflow — viewer too slow'. Landed as task 1.5 of prior terminal-attach spec.

title: [session-mgmt] Session detail page missing loading.tsx and error.tsx
description: apps/nextjs/src/app/session/[id]/page.tsx:14 has no loading.tsx or error.tsx. If fetchSessionDetail throws (agent unreachable), Next.js surfaces an unhandled error page. LazyTerminalPanel has no Suspense boundary at page level. Fix: add loading.tsx + error.tsx + Suspense boundary.

title: [session-mgmt] session-manager sweepIdle never evicts ended sessions
description: sweepIdle at apps/agent/src/session-manager.ts:105-115 does not evict ended sessions — the Map grows unboundedly. Ended sessions accumulate in memory for the lifetime of the agent process. Fix: add ended session eviction with configurable TTL.

title: [session-mgmt] All integration tests skipped post-PG migration
description: sessions.test.ts at apps/agent/src/routes/sessions.test.ts:16-74 uses .skip on all tests. Zero live coverage of GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id, status filtering, and 404 behavior after PG migration. Fix: un-skip and provide test DB fixture.

title: [session-mgmt] get/register/unregister/heartbeat missing OTel spans
description: Only start and stop session handlers have #[tracing::instrument]. handle_get_session, handle_get_sessions, handle_register_session, handle_unregister_session, and handle_heartbeat at grpc/sessions.rs:13-57 are invisible in distributed traces. Fix: add #[tracing::instrument] to all handlers.

title: [session-mgmt] handle_register_session accepts zero pid and empty fields
description: No field validation in register_session at grpc/sessions.rs:316-337 — empty cwd, zero pid, and empty session_id are silently accepted and stored. A zero pid is only caught at StopSession time. Fix: validate all required fields upfront and return InvalidArgument gRPC status.

title: [session-mgmt] SIGKILL is fire-and-forget — registry.remove() runs before process verified dead
description: handle_stop_session at grpc/sessions.rs:293-313 issues SIGKILL then sleeps 500ms then calls registry.remove() and reports success=true with 'stopped with SIGKILL' message, even if the kernel has not yet reaped the process. Fix: use waitpid with a timeout to verify death before removing from registry.
close_reason: Rust-specific — irrelevant in TS port. The TS agent (apps/agent/src/session-manager.ts) has no handle_stop_session and no SIGKILL flow. Verified: (1) routes.ts:229-262 exposes only GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id, GET /sessions/:id/tokens, POST /session/start — no stop/kill/DELETE endpoint for sessions; (2) grep 'stop_session|stopSession|SIGKILL' under apps/agent/src returns zero hits; (3) sessions end via watcher-bridge receiving session_end CC hook events (session-manager.ts:154-169) or sweepIdle promoting to 'errored' when /proc/PID gone (session-manager.ts:230-241) or startup PID validation in init() (session-manager.ts:79-88). The only kill() in the codebase at watcher-bridge.ts:169 targets the agent's own watcher child process with a graceful-shutdown-then-force-kill pattern including proc.exitCode.then() verification (lines 164-177), which already addresses the 'verify death' concern. The Rust grpc/sessions.rs:293-313 flow referenced in the bead description does not exist in the TS rewrite.

close_reason: Rust era audit-wave-1 epics; TUI crate gone; Bun notification engine has Sentry captureException in all 3 channels (desktop/slack/tts)

title: /apply:all wave-tag plan_id collision risk (date-only, not run-id-unique)
description: wave-plan.json's plan_id is generated as "apply-multi-" + today's date only (jq: (now | todate | sub("T.*"; ""))), with no run-id/sequence suffix. Two independent same-day multi-spec /apply:all runs both produce plan_id=apply-multi-2026-07-13, so Step 4.1's wave-tag naming (<plan_id>-wave-<N>) collides across runs. Reproduced 2026-07-13: an earlier same-day run (add-git-ahead-behind-status + add-session-model-authority) had already claimed tag apply-multi-2026-07-13-wave-1 locally AND on origin before a second run (fix-interact-text-frame-denial + refocus-board-shell, run_id apply-2026-07-13-002) tried to tag its own Wave 1 with the same name -- git tag -a correctly refused the local collision, but the naive push would have silently no-op'd (Everything up-to-date) instead of erroring, masking that the second run's wave completion went untagged. Worked around by tagging with the actual (already-unique) run_id (apply-2026-07-13-002-wave-1) instead of plan_id for this run; the underlying command template (commands/apply/all.md Step 4.1 / references/edge-cases.md) still generates plan_id date-only. Fix: derive plan_id from run_id (already collision-free via wave-state next-run-id's sequence number) rather than composing a fresh date-only string, or append the run_id as a disambiguating suffix when plan_id is date-derived.

title: Duplicate credential row on rotation: updateSecret() leaves 2 rows instead of 1 (nx-44mby regression)
description: Commit 6796f8ab ('fix(agent): stop duplicating credential rows on token rotation') does not actually fix the dup-row bug. Reproduced live: bun test apps/agent/src/credentials/active-credential-watcher.test.ts -t 'updateSecret() updates it in place' fails with pool.rows having length 2 instead of 1 after a rotation. Test passes in isolation (not a suite-contamination flake, unlike the sibling nx-6uzqi test in the same file which only fails in the full turbo test run). Discovered during a routine git push Tier A gate run on 2026-07-13, pre-dates this session's plan work (already on main before plan-032 started).
notes: Diagnosed via systematic-debugging: this is a TEST-HARNESS bug, not a production defect. Empirically confirmed (instrumented createFakePool.add() with a temporary console.error, ran the failing test in isolation) that production active-credential-watcher.ts's runRefresh() correctly calls pool.add() exactly once, during the cold-start 'First observation' step (previousFingerprint is null on process start / resetSnapshot(), so the rotation branch never triggers) -- this matches the documented, intentional behavior in the sibling test 'fingerprint matches existing pool row -> pool.add() still called (update-in-place mirror)'. The real production CredentialPool.add() (apps/agent/src/credentials/pool/pool-core.ts ~line 213-266) has a re-import guard: it looks up an existing row by (fingerprint, name), and if found, UPDATEs that row in place using its EXISTING id -- it never inserts a new row on a match. The test file's createFakePool().add() did not mirror this: it unconditionally pushed a new row onto pool.rows regardless of whether a matching fingerprint already existed. In the failing rotation test, the first runRefresh() call (cold start, live file already matching a pre-seeded pool row) hit this unconditional push and silently created a second row with the same id before the rotation step even began; the later updateSecret() call then only updated whichever duplicate Array.prototype.find() returned first, leaving a stale twin -- producing the observed rows.length===2. Fixed createFakePool's add() to dedupe by fingerprint (matching production's match key, since name is deterministically derived from fingerprint at every callsite in this file) and update the existing row in place instead of always pushing. Also independently re-confirmed (re-ran in isolation) that the OTHER failing test from the same push run, 'account switch via atomic rename-over updates activeFingerprint', passes cleanly standalone -- matches the documented Bun mock.module process-global contamination class (memory/reference_bun_mock_module_contamination.md), not a real bug; no fix attempted for that one per scope. Downgrading priority from P1 to P3: no production credential-rotation code was touched, and the real CredentialPool.add()/updateSecret() semantics were verified correct throughout.
close_reason: Test-harness bug, not a production defect. createFakePool().add() in active-credential-watcher.test.ts always pushed a new pool row, never mirroring the real CredentialPool.add()'s re-import guard (match-by-fingerprint+name -> update existing row in place). Fixed the fake to dedupe by fingerprint before pushing. Production active-credential-watcher.ts and the real CredentialPool.add()/updateSecret() were verified correct via source read + empirical instrumentation; zero production code changed. Full test file now 10/10 pass.

title: Add deleted/renamed counts to git-observer payload
description: Sibling ask to nx-mbnqj (ahead/behind vs upstream — already shipped via add-git-ahead-behind-status, closed 2026-07-13). cc-tmux's cc-tmux-git-status-glyphs (installfest if-ovnl) redesigned row 2's working-tree indicator into six per-category counts: modified/untracked (already in GitStatusObject.dirty), deleted, renamed, and ahead/behind (now also in GitStatusObject per nx-mbnqj's resolution). deleted/renamed counts do not exist anywhere in GitStatusObject or the git_events table. cc-tmux computes them locally via git status --porcelain=v2 --branch parsing (tmux._git_status in apps/cc-tmux/src/cc_tmux/tmux.py, installfest repo) using the same per-field dual-source pattern nx-mbnqj's fields now use: prefer nx's value when the key is present, fall back to local otherwise -- so cc-tmux needs zero code changes to adopt this once shipped. git-observer.ts's parseGitStatusV2 (which already parses porcelain=v2's '# branch.ab' line for ahead/behind per nx-mbnqj) already walks the same porcelain output where deleted ('1 <XY>' lines with D in either position) and renamed ('2 <XY>' lines) entries live -- likely a small extension of the same parser, not a new mechanism. cc-tmux's own anticipatory design guessed these would land as top-level GitStatusObject keys (alongside branch/headSha/detached/ahead/behind), not nested under dirty (which is semantically untracked-tree-cleanliness, not a home for deleted/renamed) -- confirm or correct that placement when implementing.
close_reason: Nested deleted/renamed counts into GitDirtyCounts (packages/core/src/types/git-status.ts) + extended parseGitStatusV2 (apps/agent/src/services/git-observer.ts), additive-only. Verified: bun test git-observer.test.ts + project-status.test.ts -> 145 pass/0 fail/302 expect. Commit d5536c38.

title: Add ahead/behind-vs-upstream field to git-observer payload
description: cc-tmux's cc-tmux-adopt-nx-context-and-git-status (installfest if-d3i9) needed an ahead-of-upstream count for its row-2 status bar. GET /projects/:id/status's git object (add-git-status-orbit) has no ahead/behind field anywhere in the payload or the underlying git_events table, so cc-tmux computes it locally via a new git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD shell-out instead (tmux._git_ahead in apps/cc-tmux/src/cc_tmux/tmux.py, installfest repo). If git-observer's 60s poll ever adds ahead/behind counts, cc-tmux can switch its ahead resolution from local-only to the same nx-primary/local-fallback shape branch/dirty already use. Sibling scope to bead nx-yn6c2 (session_id capture half of the same cc-tmux migration).

title: reaper-persistence.test.ts
description:
reaper-persistence.test.ts: shared beforeAll schema leaks rows across test cases, causing a false pass/fail depending on run order

services/reaper-persistence.test.ts's describe block shares one schema/db handle across all it cases via a single beforeAll with no per-test cleanup (the file's own comment at lines 223-226 acknowledges other test rows can leak in). Confirmed failing (not flaky -- deterministic) 2026-07-12: 'returns stale=true when the latest success is older than 8 days' fails because an earlier test in the same file ('persists a clear-run success with no bloat rows') inserts a fresh success row at the exact timestamp this later test uses as now, so checkReaperHeartbeat finds the leaked fresh row instead of the deliberately-inserted 10-day-old one and returns stale=false instead of true. Only fires under NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 (not the default Tier A push path). Fix: give each it case its own isolated schema/cleanup, or clear inserted rows between cases.

title: PG-gated tests cross-contaminate under NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS+NEXUS_PG_TESTS ...
description:
PG-gated tests cross-contaminate under NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS+NEXUS_PG_TESTS full-suite run (mock.module leakage)

Discovered while investigating nx-w94di (Tier A PG harness race, resolved as
DDL drift, not a race -- see that bead's close reason). After fixing the
real db.test.ts DDL drift, a full `bun test apps/agent` run with
NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 + NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS=1 (both set -- NOT the default Tier A
env, which never sets NEXUS_PG_TESTS) still showed 17 PG-gated failures that
do NOT reproduce when the same file is run standalone:

  - services/process-watcher.test.ts: 3x "reconcileOnce -- process-watcher
    diff" tests expect gitProvider "github", get null.
  - services/process-watcher.integration.test.ts: 5x backfillSessionCwd
    tests get shifted/wrong results (e.g. expects touched=0 gets 1, expects
    a written cwd gets the pre-write value) -- looks like cross-test or
    cross-file ordering contamination, not a DB race.
  - services/socket-server/dispatcher-agent-state.integration.test.ts: 2x
    agent_state read-back tests fail only in the full run.
  - db/database.test.ts: 2x verifySchema/checkSchemaForHealth "missing
    table" tests fail only in the full run (schema drop reported "does not
    exist, skipping" -- looks like the CREATE step never landed that run).

Suspect: process-watcher.test.ts does `mock.module("./git-project-resolver",
...)` at file scope with no restore in afterAll (unlike the file's own
installExecMock, which IS restored). Bun's mock.module mutates the global
module registry per absolute path, not per test file -- see
reference_bun_mock_module_contamination.md in this project's memory
(process-global forward-leaking mocks; spread real barrel / restorable
spyOn is the documented fix pattern). git-project-resolver.test.ts imports
the real module in the same process; whichever file's mock factory "wins"
depends on bun's file scheduling, which is why this only shows up in a
full-directory run and not a single-file run.

IMPORTANT: this class of flake requires NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 to even execute
(the failing tests are all `describe.skipIf(!hasPg)`), and NEXUS_PG_TESTS is
NOT part of the default Tier A pre-push invocation (confirmed: grep across
.env, deploy/, shell profiles -- not set anywhere persistent). So this does
NOT affect the standard homelab push path today. It only bites a developer
who has NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 exported in their interactive shell at push time
(the same one-off condition that likely produced the original nx-w94di
report). Filed as P3 or-fix-when-touched, not urgent.

Fix shape (not yet implemented): convert process-watcher.test.ts's
mock.module("./git-project-resolver", ...) to the installExecMock-style
restorable pattern (spyOn + real barrel spread + afterAll restore), matching
the pattern already used for execText in the same file.

title: nexus-homelab-deploy.sh 'already up to date' fast-path never triggers post-merge build/migrate hooks when interactive checkout is also the deploy target
notes: deploy/deploy-homelab.sh's fast path (lines 94-97: if BEFORE == TARGET, no-op exit 0) assumes 'repo already at origin/main' means 'nothing to deploy'. That assumption breaks when the same checkout used for interactive dev work IS ALSO the deploy target (true on homelab, where Leo works directly in the checkout the timer polls) — a commit made and pushed directly from that checkout already sets local HEAD to origin/main before the next timer tick, so git fetch shows BEFORE==TARGET and the pull-triggered post-merge build/migrate hooks never fire, even when a pending DB migration or rebuild is needed. Live incident: this session, 8 commits (including a data migration) were pushed directly from the homelab checkout; the timer no-op'd on every subsequent tick since local HEAD already matched origin/main, so the migration had to be applied manually via db:migrate instead of through the automated pipeline. Fix needs the fast-path to distinguish 'nothing new arrived from origin' from 'nothing has been built/migrated since the last successful deploy' — e.g. compare against a last-deployed-SHA marker instead of purely against origin/main, or detect local-commits-since-last-build independent of fetch state. Not fixed this session — team lead applied this cycle's migration manually. Related: nx-ybcs3 (same deploy/ area, different root cause).
close_reason: Fixed in 5564072d (last-deployed-SHA marker replaces HEAD==origin/main fast-path check, verified via a real throwaway-repo simulation covering all 3 scenarios) + 2b89a8ce (found and fixed a related PATH gap in the same unit: pnpm wasn't reachable under nexus-homelab-deploy.service's PATH at all, which would have silently broken the post-merge migrate hook even after the SHA-marker fix -- verified pnpm --version now resolves under the corrected PATH).

A single hardcoded path cannot be correct for both remotes long-term. Found while fixing the related nx-homelab-deploy NX_REPO default bug (see commit 981b8b35).

title: nexus-agent: credential store polluted — 2708 /credentials entries, only 76 with an email
description: The /credentials endpoint returns 2708 credential entries of which only 76 carry an accountEmail; the rest are null/empty rows (verified live 2026-07-11 via curl to localhost:7400/credentials). Something in the credential ingest/watch path is inserting empty rows repeatedly. Dedup and clean the store, add a guard against inserting credentials with no identifying fields, and consider excluding email-less rows from the endpoint response.
notes: Root cause already fixed in commit cc540485 (2026-07-03): CredentialPool.add() now dedupes on (fingerprint,name) instead of unconditionally inserting. Verified live: zero duplicate groups created since that fix landed -- all 2611 email-less rows are pre-fix backlog. The identifying-fields guard also already exists: computeCredentialFingerprint() throws CredentialParseError before any insert if the OAuth blob is missing/malformed, and both watcher call sites derive a non-empty name (basename of filename, or acct-<fingerprint prefix>) -- no code path inserts a nameless/fingerprintless row. Characterized the backlog (all 2611 candidate rows are non-primary with a live primary sibling in the same duplicate_group_id, zero cross-table references in sessions/session_token_turns/credential_polls, dry-run DELETE verified via BEGIN/ROLLBACK: 2611 deleted, 103 remain) and drafted migration 0050_cleanup_orphaned_credential_duplicates.sql (commit 9d7abdde), NOT applied to live DB -- pending review/deploy. Leaving open until the migration deploys and the live /credentials count is re-verified.
close_reason: Migration 0050 applied live 2026-07-12 12:38 UTC via db:migrate. Verified: credentials table 2714->103 rows (-2611, exact match to dry-run estimate), 0 remaining duplicate-with-live-primary rows, 0 orphaned credential_polls references, sessions unaffected (no FK to credentials). Post-rebuild agent logs confirm the pre-migration credential re-import ambiguity warnings are gone.

notes: Root cause: pervasive process-global mock.module pollution across the notifications suites (not just @nexus/db). Six+ suites installed PARTIAL irreversible mock.module stubs of @nexus/db, ./buffer, ./router, ../services/lifecycle-bus, @nexus/core/node; last-writer-wins clobbered siblings. manager.integration also had a real second bug (missing ELEVENLABS_DEFAULT_VOICE_ID). Verification: bun test apps/agent/src/notifications/ now 167 pass / 0 fail (was ~18 fail), stable 3x. Full agent turbo-test suite: baseline 1063 pass/54 fail -> 1091 pass/54 fail, ZERO new failures, 15 non-PG named failures FIXED. Agent typecheck unchanged (9 pre-existing errors). Remaining 54 are all 'requires live PG' env skips.

Full agent turbo-test: 1063->1091 pass, 54->54 fail with ZERO new regressions and 15 non-PG named failures fixed. Shared spread-real mocks (mock-nexus-db/mock-core-node) + restorable spyOn (testing-mocks) replace partial irreversible mock.module stubs. Typecheck unchanged (9 pre-existing). Tier A flake gate cleared.

title: Deploy gate: Tier A test failure strands local homelab agent (source ahead of binary)
description: When a commit is authored+pushed FROM homelab, the pre-push 01-deploy hook runs the Tier A 'bun test' gate. It fails on ~38 pre-existing live-PG/infra tests and aborts the deploy pipeline. Consequences observed 2026-06-19 (add-api-error-notification, 4780c65e): (1) the LOCAL homelab nexus-agent is never rebuilt/restarted -- pre-push aborts and post-merge 02-deploy never fires on a local commit -- leaving repo HEAD ahead of the running binary (verified: 0 isApiErrorMessage strings in running binary while source had the feature). (2) The Mac's post-merge 02-deploy fans BACK to homelab when the diff touches apps/agent/, causing a redundant restart loop; safe Mac sync requires 'git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null pull --ff-only'. Manual unblock that works: 'bun run --filter @nexus/agent build && systemctl --user restart nexus-agent'. Fix options: (a) make Tier A gate ignore the known-pre-existing infra failures or split them out; (b) add a local post-commit agent-rebuild path independent of the test gate; (c) make 02-deploy skip fan-out to hosts that run no agent. Relates to existing P3 test-harness debt.
close_reason: Verified the stranding consequence is resolved for the cited cause: with the exact default Tier A env (NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS=1, no POSTGRES_URL/NEXUS_PG_TESTS -- confirmed neither is set anywhere persistent in this repo/shell), bun test apps/agent now finishes with only 2 pre-existing failures (forwardOrLocal x3, active-credential-watcher x1), both unrelated to PG/DDL and already being worked by other in-flight fixes this session. Before the nx-w94di fix (6c8e7ce7), db.test.ts's DDL drift would abort Tier A on any push where a developer's shell happened to export NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 (the same one-off condition that produced the original 2026-06-19 incident) -- that path is now clean. No gate-bypass or policy change needed.

title: Tier A pre-push gate cannot distinguish broken harness from real regression

Retry-once contract defeated by deterministic-under-load failures. Consider quarantining the PG-integration leg or a load-aware gate.
close_reason: The specific incident this bead cites (retry-once defeated by the PG harness failing deterministically on both attempts) is resolved by nx-w94di's root-cause fix (6c8e7ce7) -- that failure no longer occurs, verified 3x. Separately confirmed NEXUS_PG_TESTS is not set anywhere in the default Tier A pre-push path (.env/deploy/shell profiles), so PG-gated suites skip cleanly there by design; the retry-once contract only needs to absorb genuine CPU-contention timing flakes, which it already does. A different, real load-order-dependent flake class was found during this investigation (mock.module cross-contamination, NOT a DB race) but it only manifests when a developer has NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 exported at push time -- tracked separately as nx-rzaej, not a reason to add gate complexity here.

title: PG integration tests race schema drop/recreate under NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS load
description: The (requires live PG) tests in @nexus/agent drop+recreate an isolated schema mid-run and race under heavy concurrent load (column stop_reason does not exist mid-migration). Pass in isolation. Should gate on hasPg cleanly or serialize the drop/recreate. Surfaced during notification-fidelity /apply Tier A pre-push.
close_reason: Root cause was misdiagnosed as a schema drop/recreate race under NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS load. Actual bug: db.test.ts's own hand-copied DDL strings (SESSION_CRUD_DDL, RETENTION_DDL) had drifted from the live Drizzle schema -- missing stop_reason/error_details columns and the cron_runs/bloat_radar/spec_sessions tables that runRetentionCleanup deletes from. 100% deterministic failure, reproduced 3x with zero concurrent load, not load-sensitive. The isolated-pg-schema.ts per-run unique-schema pattern used by every PG-gated suite is race-free by design -- verified via 3x repeated full-suite runs under NEXUS_HEAVY_TESTS=1+NEXUS_PG_TESTS=1 with zero variance. Fixed in 6c8e7ce7 (both DDL blocks now match production schema); 18/18 db.test.ts tests pass, reproduced clean 3x standalone + inside the full agent suite.

title: Add credential_swaps table to track per-session credential rotation history
description: From attribution.ts:42 TODO, filed as tracking for deferred future work. When credential_swaps table is added to Bun DB schema: (1) Query credential_id + swapped_at from credential_swaps where session_id = X and swapped_at <= turn_ts, ordered by swapped_at DESC limit 1. (2) If swap matches, look up credentials.fingerprint for that credential_id. (3) If no swap matches, fall through to the session-level fallback in attribution.ts. Would give accurate per-turn credential attribution for rate-limit analysis. Currently using session-level fallback which is correct but coarse.
close_reason: Closing as obsolete, not implemented. Investigation found the bead's premise no longer matches the codebase: attribution.ts (apps/agent/src/credentials/token-stream/attribution.ts, where the line-42 TODO lived) was deleted entirely in commit a8646685 (2026-07-05, 'proactive credential swap + read cc telemetry from VictoriaMetrics') as part of retiring the whole transcript-tail cost-reconstruction path -- that commit's own message notes sessionTokenTurns/sessionTokenWatcherState now have zero writers. Per-session cost/token reads now come from VictoriaMetrics (telemetry/session-cost-read.ts) with no per-turn granularity at all, so there is no live consumer for the credential_id+swapped_at query the TODO described. A credentialSwaps DB table does already exist (packages/db/src/schema/credentialSwaps.ts) but it's schema-only/zero-writer, built for an unrelated spec (credential-pool-correctness swap auditing), and shaped differently (from/to fingerprint + created_at, not credential_id/swapped_at) than what the TODO wanted. This bead was originally filed as a pure tracking bead for a deferred TODO (nx-ajr1 -> nx-ipj7), not a committed feature -- building against a retired feature path now would ship dead code with no caller. Reviewed and agreed by team-lead.

title: Refine A9 (unhandled Promise rejection) to recognize chain-terminal .catch() and safeFireAndForget wrapper
description:
A9 rule flags `.then()` at line N even when:

1. A `.catch()` terminates the same chain later (e.g. `import().then(A).catch(B).then(C).catch(D)` \u2014 rule flags C because it sees `.then()` without adjacent `.catch()`)
2. The entire promise expression is wrapped by a helper like `safeFireAndForget(p, ctx)` that adds its own `.catch()`

Currently suppressed via .audit-suppressions.json for apps/agent/src/session-manager.ts + apps/agent/src/watcher-bridge.ts.

Refine the A9 detector to:
- Walk chained method calls and consider a chain safe if ANY `.catch()` appears before the chain terminates at a statement boundary
- Recognize known wrapper calls (`safeFireAndForget(...)`) as adding error handling
- Optionally: two-arg `.then(onOk, onErr)` form

Once refined, remove the A9 entry from .audit-suppressions.json.

Related: fix-audit-real-debt task 2.4 (nx-9v64).
close_reason: Resolved by fix-audit-scan-rules-pass2 task 1.1: A9 rule now widens catch lookahead to 60 lines + detects safeFireAndForget wrapper via 5-line backward scan. Verified against all 3 original sites (session-manager.ts:319, watcher-bridge.ts:119, CommandPalette.tsx:131).

title: credentials pool: recoverExpiredCooldowns() called outside lease() transaction
